routerUrl.description: Memory Router base URL. HTTPS only; certificate verification is mandatory; no credentials in the URL.

agents.description: Per-agent routing: token (SecretRef), writeBank, recallBanks. Keyed by trusted OpenClaw agent ID. Unknown agents fail closed; there is no global fallback token.

token.description: Memory Router token (mr_<key-id>_<secret>). Set via SecretRef, e.g. { "source": "exec", "provider": "op", "id": "memory-router-main" }.

writeBank.description: Default write bank for auto-retain and knowledge-tool writes.

recallBanks.description: Banks auto-recall and the recall tool fan out to. Empty means no recall.

autoRecall.description: Recall memories on every prompt and inject them as context.

recallTimeoutMs.description: Shared timeout across all recall banks.

recallMaxTokens.description: Shared recall context token budget across all banks.

recallBudget.description: Hindsight recall budget passed through per bank.

recallTypes.description: Memory types to recall (world, experience, observation).

preferObservations.description: Prefer consolidated observations in recall results.

recallTopK.description: Cap on injected memories after multi-bank merge and ranking.

recallPromptPreamble.description: Preamble prepended to the injected hindsight_memories block.

recallInjectionPosition.description: Where recalled memories are injected (user context, or system prompt prepend/append).

retainTags.description: Tags applied to every retained document.

retainContext.description: Interpretation guidance sent via the retain API context field.

retainSource.description: Source value written into retained document metadata.

enableKnowledgeTools.description: Register agent_knowledge_* tools. They use the same identity and routing rules as auto-recall/retain.

queueDir.description: Directory for per-agent retain queue files (hindsight-retain-queue.<agent>.jsonl).

retainQueueMaxAgeMs.description: Max age of queued retains (-1 keeps forever).

ignoreSessionPatterns.description: Session-key glob patterns excluded from retain.

statelessSessionPatterns.description: Session-key glob patterns treated as stateless (no retain).
